reason: My doctor said my magnesium could be low, and I want a known dose from bisglycinate, not oxide. A named lab with the batch report matching the box is what I check for, and almost nobody shows it. At $24.99 for a first box with a money-back guarantee, I would try one.
objection: It costs more than Toplux or Goli, and I would want to open the lab report and check it is real and matches the batch number before I pay. 200 mg elemental for 2 capsules is also something I would compare against what my doctor suggests.
would_change_my_mind: If the lab report on the product page turned out to be generic or not for a specific batch, or the lab name could not be verified, I would not buy.
